faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Scientist II (Non-Medical), 1 Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application on plain paper) and send it to Office of Dr. Rashmi Kushwaha, Professor, Hematology Unit, Department of Pathology, KGMU, Lucknow, by by post or hand, to reach by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: @67,000 + 13,400 (20% HRA) = Rs80,400 pm for Scientist II (Non-Medical), @20,000 + 4000 (20% HRA) = Rs 24,000 pm for Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scientist II (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree (including integrated PG) with three years post-qualification experience OR PhD in Bioscience/any stream of Science. Technical Support III: Three-year Graduate degree in relevant subject/field with three years post-qualification experience or PG in relevant subject/field. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.answer: Yes. No T.A./ D.A will be admissible for attending interview.

faq.answer: Interview. Interview on 28-11-2026 at 11:00 A.M.

faq.answer: Posts are under a research scheme under Prof. Rashmi Kushwaha, Department of Pathology.

faq.answer: Department of Pathology, KGMU, Lucknow.
